Subject: Stage stewardship roundup — manager → leadership handoff

Hi all,

Quick one: finance wants a clean leadership-ready view of stage commits and blockers by EOD today so the exec packet can be finalized for next week’s QBR. I’ve attached the working tracker (Q4_stage_readiness_tracker.xlsx) — please do the following by 4:30pm PT: 

• Update the "Manager Notes" and "Confidence" columns for all your open commits (only include deals where you plan to push a commit into the QBR slate).
• Mark any commit that requires a discount/credit or contract/legal work in the "Escalation" column and add a one-line rationale.
• Add a short (1–2 line) leadership-ready bullet under your stage owner row — we’ll pull these straight into the exec doc.

If you won’t be able to hit 4:30pm, reply here with which rows you’ll miss and who’s covering. I’ll collate everything and send a leadership-ready bundle (leadership-ready-exec-bullets.md) to execs at 5:15pm PT.

Note: Acme is on the list — I’ve cc’d procurement for visibility in case final PO timing shifts.

Thanks,
Sofia

Redwood Inference
